sloka: ब्राह्ममस्त्रं ततो धीमान् मानयित्वा तु मारुतिः।विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा हनुमांस्तमथाब्रवीत् ।। ६.७४.५ ।।
transliteration: brāhmamastraṁ tato dhīmān mānayitvā tu mārutiḥ।vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hanumāṁstamathābravīt ।। 6.74.5 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, hearing Vibheeshana's words, wise Hanuman spoke this with respect to the missile of Brahma.
